_about: Public-domain Thomas Haweis (1734-1820), evangelical, founder of the London Missionary Society, for the Word Hoard: An Impartial and Succinct History of the Rise, Declension and Revival of the Church of Christ (London 1800, three volumes), Evangelical Principles and Practice (Newburyport 1803) and the Life of William Romaine (1797), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 43 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

haweis-history-1: An impartial and succinct history of the rise, declension, and revival of the Church of Christ; from the birth of our saviour to the present time. By the Rev. T. Haweis, In three volumes. vol. 1 (catalogued 1800)
